title: Structured Non-Locality and Emergent Locality in Cavity-QED Many-Body Dynamics
summary: Cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) modifies many-body systems by combining cavity-mediated collective interactions with microscopic short-range interactions. The resulting dynamics lies between the local and fully collective limits, such that neither locality nor collectivity alone provides a complete organizing principle.
